milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_log block drops a birch_log item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no birch_log (verified in sandbox with /clear command showing 'No items found'). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_nether_bricks with a pickaxe drops a red_nether_bricks item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no red_nether_bricks (verified in sandbox). Crucially, red nether bricks REQUIRE at least a wooden pickaxe to drop as an item — breaking by hand yields nothing. This enforces the hard dependency: player must first mine birch logs, craft a wooden pickaxe, then mine these blocks. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
